msg: PC13 sinks the LED: abs-max sink 3 mA through the power switch (STM32F103C8T6 DS5319 Table 5 note 5, parts/C8734.json)
LED should visibly light (>= 0.5 mA) when PC13 drives low - a dead indicator is a functional miss, not a safety one
driven-low LED cathode should sit near VOL (< 0.4 V); higher means the pin model or chain resistance is off
